corpus.historical_test_policy: Previously inspected regression partition; no untouched-holdout generalization claim.

original_score_scope: First read only, fresh autonomous discovery and reader per original/variant. Bar/caption metadata never replace exact counts or N/A.
timing_scope: 50 fresh Frame containers with identical original pixels and increasing synthetic timestamps;20 outside-evidence background-pixel changes separately. Reading only; acquisition/copy/discovery excluded. Not native sequence evidence.

generated_policy_traces.scope: Hand-constructed current decoder outputs and independently supplied bar/max evidence. Exercises actual guard policy, not visual detection, OCR, capture, live error frequency or native recovery.

native_sequence_evidence.event_screenshot_scope: Viewport crops without Skills/resource captions; unsuitable for this temporal benchmark.

limitations: Static originals test regression and latency, not temporal benefit or live freshness.
Previously inspected test split is regression evidence.
Generated policy diagnostics and native sequence acceptance must remain separate.
Bar availability across the full corpus is not a new manually annotated percentage-accuracy benchmark. Focused visual checks validate six intervals on three development originals.
Generated policy traces inject deliberately chosen decoder errors; their error reductions are mechanism tests, not measured live error rates.

Numeric-only confirmation delays legitimate changes by one incoming frame and may stay N/A during continuous changes. Combined mode bypasses only with independently verified same-maximum bar movement.
Repeated identical wrong digits can pass temporal confirmation. Bar width cannot uniquely recover exact counts; obscured values remain N/A.
Only the supported horizontal status-bar family is measured; side/parallel/mana-shield layouts are unavailable.
recommendation: Keep the robust decoder as the exact-value source. Use optional current-frame bar checks; evaluate combined short confirmation on reviewed native gameplay before enabling it in the normal runtime. No default changed.

report_correction.issue: Aggregate false_panel_acceptances included a pre-existing reference_diagnostic flag for dfg-demolidores-4KCJ. It is not one of the 17 safety controls.
report_correction.resolution: Retain the aggregate flag explicitly, classify safety controls with the existing corpus scorer, and reject forged role changes. No image, annotation, reader, value or timing changed.

targeted_repeat.scope: Repeat of shard 7 at identical source and input hashes; all output values, qualities and regions unchanged. Original failed timing retained.
targeted_repeat.interpretation: The 154.82 ms bar-only background p95 did not reproduce. No telemetry identifies the cause; this repeat does not erase the initial budget failure.
